notes.title: The Dirt Track at Charlotte
notes.notes:
The Dirt Track at Charlotte releases on November 20, 2020!

This track will be available in ALL series and ALL modes of play for Tony Sewart's All American Racing, including Career Mode and Online Multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672427/e74f368a60de4c0e91542cb075c5d7e8edea844a.png[/img]

notes.title: Go all-in at The Dirt Track at Las Vegas Motor Speedway!
notes.notes:
Roll the dice at The Dirt Track at Las Vegas Motor Speedway! This half-mile track is coming to Tony Stewart's All-American Racing on Friday, November 6!

Once installed, this track will be available in ALL series and ALL modes of play, including Career Mode and Online Multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672427/8c6e6057cae29ace6921c70e0ecd6ed5325a7e21.png[/img]

notes.title: Late Models
notes.notes:
Late Models are coming to Tony Stewart's All-American Racing!

Expand your racing empire by starting a Late Model team in Career Mode, and then see how you compare in Online Multiplayer, run some practice laps in Quick Race, or compete in a Late Model Championship.

Mark your calendars: Late Models hit on October 23rd!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38672427/de7acef9bceb811ba9c8df54d5e04af552bc9bcf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch Notes (September 17, 2020)
notes.notes:
We released a small patch for [i]Tony Stewart's All-American[/i] Racing today. This patch includes:

[list]
[*] Car editor: Added new car number fonts
[*] Audio: Fixed Modified engine sound
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes (September 14, 2020)
notes.notes:
We released a small patch for [i]Tony Stewart's All-American[/i] Racing today. This patch includes:

[list]
[*] Career: Fixed rare bug where part prices would be inconsistent
[*] Career: Adjusted pricing for Street Stock and Legend parts
[*] Career: Custom team names can now be up to 26 characters long
[*] Career: Correctly display "average finish" for previous season stats, instead of "races"
[*] Audio: Adjusted Modified engine audio
[*] Car/Outfit editor: added new sponsor decals "Tony Stewart Racing" and "LakeSide Media"
[*] General: Fixed some achievement unlocking
[*] Other fixes and improvements
[/list]
